implementation.workflow: Build debug APK and Android tests
implementation.environment: GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest; JDK 17; Gradle 8.9; Android API 35; google_apis x86_64; Pixel 7 Pro profile

B4.hypothesis: provider completes the effect; caller process dies before local completion persistence; restart classifies UNKNOWN and reconciles by operation identity without redispatch

B5.hypothesis: caller process dies after durable reservation but before provider dispatch; restart proves provider operation absent, reconciles CONFIRMED_NOT_EXECUTED, then dispatches exactly once
